title: TV unit and bookcase either side of a fireplace
summary: A TV unit in one alcove and a bookcase in the other, both with panelled cupboards underneath, built in MDF.
intro: A living room with a tiled fireplace and an empty alcove either side of the chimney breast. The left alcove became a TV unit: three panelled cupboard doors below, shelves above and a space sized for the television. The right alcove became a bookcase, with cupboards underneath finished with green inset panels. It is the same room as the picture-frame panelling on the long wall.

cover.alt: Living room with an MDF TV unit in the left alcove, the fireplace and mirror in the middle and a bookcase in the right alcove

steps.title: Base and back panel first
steps.text: Day one: the base cupboard went in with its panelled doors, and a full MDF back panel lined the alcove so the shelves have something solid to sit against.

image.alt: Base cupboard with panelled doors and an MDF back panel lining the alcove

steps.title: Cut in the room
steps.text: Boards cut to size on trestles in the middle of the room.

image.alt: MDF boards on trestles in the middle of the living room

steps.title: Frames and shelves
steps.text: The front frame went on next, then the shelves, set at heights worked out around the television and the soundbar.

image.alt: Side frames and two shelves fitted in the left alcove

steps.title: Room inside
steps.text: Each cupboard has a shelf inside. The doors open wide enough to get a games console or a box of cables in and out.

image.alt: Cupboard doors open, showing a shelf inside the base

steps.title: The bookcase side
steps.text: The right alcove got deeper shelves for books and the same cupboard base, this time with green inset panels in the doors.

image.alt: The right alcove bookcase with green panels set into the cupboard doors
